property.name: AcceptsFocus
property.description-key: Determines whether the control can receive keyboard focus.

property.name: AccessibleLabel
property.description-key: Descriptive label exposed to screen readers and other assistive technology.

property.name: Align
property.description-key: Sets the horizontal alignment of the button's content.

property.name: Appearance
property.description-key: Selects the button's predefined visual style.

property.name: AutoDisableOnSelect
property.description-key: Automatically disables the button while its `OnSelect` formula executes.

property.name: BasePaletteColor
property.description-key: Sets the base colour from which the Modern theme generates the button palette.

property.name: BorderColor
property.description-key: Sets the colour of the button border.

property.name: BorderStyle
property.description-key: Sets the button border style.

property.name: BorderThickness
property.description-key: Sets the thickness of the button border in pixels.

property.name: Color
property.description-key: Sets the colour of the button label text.

property.name: ContentLanguage
property.description-key: Specifies the language used for the control's content.

property.name: DisabledBorderColor
property.description-key: Sets the border colour when `DisplayMode` is Disabled.

property.name: DisabledColor
property.description-key: Sets the text colour when the button is disabled.

property.name: DisabledFill
property.description-key: Sets the background colour when the button is disabled.

property.name: DisplayMode
property.description-key: Determines whether the button is active, disabled or displayed read-only.

property.name: Fill
property.description-key: Sets the normal background colour of the button.

property.name: FocusedBorderColor
property.description-key: Sets the border colour when the control has keyboard focus.

property.name: FocusedBorderThickness
property.description-key: Sets the border thickness when the button has keyboard focus.

property.name: Font
property.description-key: Sets the font family used for the button text.

property.name: FontWeight
property.description-key: Sets the weight or thickness of the button text.

property.name: Height
property.description-key: Sets the vertical size of the button.

property.name: HoverBorderColor
property.description-key: Sets the border colour while the pointer hovers over the button.

property.name: HoverColor
property.description-key: Sets the text colour while the pointer hovers over the button.

property.name: HoverFill
property.description-key: Sets the background colour while the pointer hovers over the button.

property.name: Icon
property.description-key: Specifies the Fluent icon displayed within the button.

property.name: IconStyle
property.description-key: Determines whether the button's icon uses an outline or filled style.

property.name: IconRotation
property.description-key: Rotates the button icon by the specified number of degrees.

property.name: Layout
property.description-key: Determines the position of the icon relative to the button text.

property.name: Italic
property.description-key: Determines whether the button text is italicised.

property.name: OnSelect
property.description-key: Power Fx formula executed when the user activates the button.

property.name: PaddingBottom
property.description-key: Sets the space between the button content and its bottom edge.

property.name: PaddingLeft
property.description-key: Sets the space between the button content and its left edge.

property.name: PaddingRight
property.description-key: Sets the space between the button content and its right edge.

property.name: PaddingTop
property.description-key: Sets the space between the button content and its top edge.

property.name: PressedBorderColor
property.description-key: Sets the border colour while the button is being pressed.

property.name: PressedColor
property.description-key: Sets the text colour while the button is being pressed.

property.name: PressedFill
property.description-key: Sets the background colour while the button is being pressed.

property.name: RadiusBottomLeft
property.description-key: Sets the radius of the bottom-left corner.

property.name: RadiusBottomRight
property.description-key: Sets the radius of the bottom-right corner.

property.name: RadiusTopLeft
property.description-key: Sets the radius of the top-left corner.

property.name: RadiusTopRight
property.description-key: Sets the radius of the top-right corner.

property.name: Size
property.description-key: Sets the font size of the button label.

property.name: Strikethrough
property.description-key: Determines whether a line appears through the button text.

property.name: TabIndex
property.description-key: Defines the button's position in keyboard tab navigation.

property.name: Text
property.description-key: Specifies the label displayed on the button.

property.name: Tooltip
property.description-key: Sets explanatory text displayed when the pointer hovers over the control.

property.name: Underline
property.description-key: Determines whether the button text is underlined.

property.name: VerticalAlign
property.description-key: Sets the vertical alignment of content within the button.

property.name: Visible
property.description-key: Determines whether the control is rendered in the app.

property.name: Width
property.description-key: Sets the horizontal size of the button.

property.name: Wrap
property.description-key: Determines whether button text wraps onto multiple lines when required.

property.name: X
property.description-key: Sets the horizontal position relative to the button's parent.

property.name: Y
property.description-key: Sets the vertical position relative to the button's parent.
